article.title: Elephant discrimination
article.excerpt: Elephants are able to differentiate between ethnicities and genders, and can tell an adult from a child – all from the sound of a human voice. This is according to a study in which researchers played voice recordings to wild African elephants. The animals showed more fear when they heard the voices of adult Masai men.
